steps.text:
Разбиваем: $\sin x\cos^3 x = \cos^4 x \cdot \frac{\sin x}{\cos x} = \cos^4 x \cdot \tan x$.

Значит:
$$\frac{1}{\sqrt{\sin x\cos^3 x}} = \frac{1}{\cos^2 x \cdot \sqrt{\tan x}} = \frac{\sec^2 x}{\sqrt{\tan x}}$$
